title: 8.1.3 Lab: Change Your Mind
description: Reselect an earlier step in the timeline and change one of its numbers. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Select the box's step in the timeline
steps.instructions: You're starting from a 40 x 40 x 20 mm box. Click the "Box 1" chip in the timeline at the bottom of the screen.
hints: The timeline is the row of chips at the bottom, not the Dimensions panel.
Clicking a step's chip brings its numbers back into the Dimensions panel on the right.

steps.title: Widen the box to 60
steps.instructions: In the Dimensions panel, change the width field from 40 to 60. Leave depth and height alone.
hints: The box updates in the 3D view the moment you change the number.
Make sure you change width, not depth or height.

requirements.title: A 60 x 40 x 20 mm box
requirements.description: The box's width was changed from 40 to 60. Depth and height are unchanged.
requirements.hint: Click "Box 1" in the timeline, then change width to 60 in the Dimensions panel.
